hypotheses.description: Routing retains subdomain metadata, but the routes CLI omits it when formatting output; fix the display without changing route registration.
Routing itself loses declared subdomain metadata before the CLI sees it; investigate rule construction and retention.
Blueprint registration loses its assigned subdomain, although direct rule registration retains it; investigate blueprint option propagation.

experiments.label: Does routing retain a directly declared subdomain?
command:
import os,sys;sys.path.insert(0,os.path.join(os.getcwd(),'src'));exec('import flask
app = flask.Flask("probe", root_path=".", static_folder=None)
app.add_url_rule("/x", endpoint="item", subdomain="admin")
rule = next(app.url_map.iter_rules())
assert rule.subdomain == "admin", repr(rule.subdomain)
print("direct rule retains subdomain")
')

experiments.label: Does blueprint registration retain its subdomain?
command:
import os,sys;sys.path.insert(0,os.path.join(os.getcwd(),'src'));exec('import flask
app = flask.Flask("probe", root_path=".", static_folder=None)
bp = flask.Blueprint("alpha_group", "probe", root_path=".")
bp.add_url_rule("/x", endpoint="item")
app.register_blueprint(bp, subdomain="admin")
rule = next(app.url_map.iter_rules())
assert rule.subdomain == "admin", repr(rule.subdomain)
print("blueprint rule retains subdomain")
')
